title: Recover original hello authentication and client-process identity gates

claimedPid.equality: RVA 0x3C4291 compares OS-reported client PID with hello-supplied PID

clientProcessImage.openProcess: RVA 0x3C42E1 loads PROCESS_QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION 0x1000; RVA 0x3C42EB calls OpenProcess
clientProcessImage.expectedPathInput: connection future passes the host-held expected client path at RVA 0x0E3FD7 -> 0x3C424B
clientProcessImage.comparison: length equality followed by ASCII A-Z case-folded byte equality at RVA 0x3C4538-0x3C4584 after helper normalization
clientProcessImage.productionPolicy: Do not implement or bypass this gate until the pre-comparison normalization helpers are source-backed.

registryAdmission.profileId: exact pending-record length and byte comparison
registryAdmission.token: SHA-256(raw token), fixed 32-byte XOR accumulator comparison
registryAdmission.route: connected route installed only after all admission gates pass

remainingBlocker: Recover the exact client-image path normalization performed before the case-insensitive comparison, then implement isolated framed hello + five-second timeout + hello.ack using all recovered PID/path/build/token gates before production listener wiring.
